$comment: CLEAN-05 — registry of every COMMITTED generated artifact in this repository.
1. COVERAGE — every tracked file whose first lines carry a generation
marker ('AUTOGENERATED' / 'Code generated by ... DO NOT EDIT') must
appear in exactly one entry below.
2. FRESHNESS — every entry with a `check` command runs that command; a
3. NON-MUTATION — every declared `paths` AND `sources` entry is content-
digested (sha-256, recursive, deterministic order) before and after the
run, plus `git status --porcelain` for undeclared paths. Sources are
digested too because several generators can write their own inputs
(the i18n split rewrites `known-missing-keys.json`, the namespace audit
rewrites its baseline), and those inputs are routinely already dirty on
a feature branch — so neither status codes nor output-only digests
would notice a `--check` repairing one in place.
A generator that can only verify by regenerating declares `check: null`
plus `checkOwner`, and runs in its own dedicated CI job instead.
`check.cwd` is relative to the repository root. `check.command` is executed

artifacts.note: Directory entry: the split emits ~150 locale-*.json bundles whose exact set is itself derived from the manifest, so the generator owns the whole directory rather than a fixed file list. `known-missing-keys.json`, `shell-runtime-keys.json` and `namespace-audit-baseline.json` are declared as SOURCES because the split (and the namespace audit that runs beside it in the same buildStart plugin) can WRITE them in non-check mode — they are digested before/after so a `--check` that repairs one in place is caught even when the file is already dirty.

artifacts.checkOwner: make gen-tesla-check (.github/workflows/proto-gen-check.yml). protoc-gen style codegen has no --check mode: the target regenerates and then diffs, so it MUTATES the worktree by design and must stay in its own job rather than in the non-mutating freshness gate.
go test ./cmd/protogen-tesla/... — the golden fixtures ARE the assertion; a drifted golden fails the package test rather than a codegen gate.

ORPHANED — the header names `gen-themes.mjs`, which is not present anywhere in the repository (verified by file search). The 140 presets are therefore hand-maintained data despite the AUTOGENERATED banner. Behaviour is pinned by web/src/components/ui/themePresets.test.ts.
